name: Victorian public transport concession for Health Care Card holders
summary: Half-price myki fares on Victorian public transport for Health Care Card holders, separate from the student concession.
key: Most concession fares are 50% of the full fare.
catches: You must carry your valid concession card and/or proof of age card when you travel.
For contactless payment you need to link your concession entitlement to your card or device.
